Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JACOB, frail but determined. He is presented with a certificate and a plaque, and the room erupts in applause.

JACOB: (tearfully) Oh, Thank You. I Never Thought I'd See The Day.

The officials and reporters swarm around him, congratulating him on his incredible achievement. Jacob smiles, basking in the attention.

CUT TO:

INT. JACOB'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jacob lies in bed, the certificate and plaque on his nightstand. He gazes at them, a look of wonder on his face. Suddenly, his eyes glaze over, and he begins to speak in a hushed tone.

JACOB: (to himself) Quantum Immortality... I Remember Reading About It In My Youth...

He starts to pace around the room, his mind racing.

JACOB: (excitedly) It Said That If You Live Long Enough, You'll Eventually Experience Every Possible Branch Of Reality. Every Possible Universe. And That You'll Be The Only One Who Remembers It All.

As he speaks, his words become more frantic, his voice rising to a near-shriek.

JACOB: (desperately) But What If I'm Not Just One Person? What If I'm Every Person Who Ever Lived? What If I'm Every Possible Version Of Myself?

Jacob's eyes roll back in his head, and he collapses onto the bed, his body shaking with sobs.

CUT TO:

INT. JACOB'S MIND - NIGHT

We see a kaleidoscope of images, each one representing a different branch of reality. Jacob's mind is flooded with memories, experiences, and emotions from every possible universe. He sees himself as a young man, falling in love with his wife. He sees himself as an old man, watching his children grow up. He sees himself as a scientist, discovering the secrets of the universe.

But with each new image, Jacob's mind becomes more fragmented, more disjointed. He sees himself as a monster, terrorizing a small town. He sees himself as a god, ruling over a kingdom of angels. He sees himself as nothing, a mere speck of dust in an infinite universe.

Jacob's mind is consumed by the sheer weight of his own existence. He is overwhelmed by the infinite possibilities, the endless branches of reality.

CUT TO:

INT. JACOB'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jacob lies in bed, his body still shaking with sobs. His eyes are open, staring blankly into space. He is lost in a sea of madness, unable to distinguish reality from fantasy.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. JACOB'S HOUSE - DAY

The sun rises over the quiet neighborhood, casting a warm glow over the house. Jacob's family and friends gather outside, concerned for his well-being. They try to rouse him, but he remains still, lost in his own private hell.

The camera pans up to the sky, where a single bird flies overhead, carrying a small piece of paper with the words "Quantum Immortality" scribbled on it.

FADE TO BLACK.
